recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. The current specification conveys the intended representation through Appointment rather than Encounter; future waitlist or encounter-request modeling should remain with later dedicated trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-6938 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It asked how to communicate planned encounters that were not yet scheduled when Appointment required start/end date-times, and the resolution directed using Appointment's proposed status from tracker 5713, making start/end optional for proposed or cancelled appointments, adding minutesDuration, and using comments/notes for scheduling guidance.
initial_application: Historical commit 44a2cf49ea applied the Appointment/AppointmentResponse reconciliation for trackers including 6938 and 5713 by adding proposed status support, changing Appointment.start and Appointment.end to 0..1, adding minutesDuration, and expanding notes/usage guidance. Commit 8db2dceb19 specifically referenced tracker 6938 and corrected app-3 so proposed and cancelled appointments can be missing start/end dates.
additional_context: FHIR-5713 is the supporting proposed-status decision named in the FHIR-6938 resolution. FHIR-5702, the related proposed-Encounter discussion, was closed no-change, supporting the absence of an Encounter status edit. FHIR-18824 later added waitlist as another Appointment status that may omit start/end, explaining the current waitlist-inclusive app-3 wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope Appointment source already has proposed status, start/end cardinality 0..1, app-3 requiring start/end except for proposed/cancelled/waitlist statuses, minutesDuration, requestedPeriod guidance, and Appointment.note guidance for planned appointments whose start/end are not set. Encounter remains active but does not require a proposed status change under the final issue trail.
